resources.string: Restore the %1$s limit and switch Streaming Quality to Custom so this limit is used. Display, audio and subtitle settings stay as they are.
Choose which HDR formats LumaFin reports as supported to Jellyfin. Auto uses device detection. Overrides do not add HDR support to your TV or player.
Use device detection for this format. Recommended unless detection is incorrect; selecting Auto also removes a manual override.
Report this format as supported even if detection says otherwise. Use only when your device and display can play it.
Report this format as unsupported. Jellyfin may convert the video or offer another version, depending on server support.
Bitstream sends encoded audio to compatible audio equipment for decoding. These choices change the support reported to Jellyfin.
Use detected audio passthrough support. Recommended; selecting Auto also removes a manual override.
Report passthrough support even if detection says otherwise. The device, connection and TV or receiver must support this format.
Report passthrough as unsupported for this format. Jellyfin may convert the audio to a compatible format.

This is the maximum decoding level reported to Jellyfin, not a picture-quality setting. Leave Auto selected unless device detection is incorrect. An unsupported manual level can cause playback failures; a lower level may cause server conversion.
Use the detected decoding level. Recommended; selecting Auto removes a manual level override.
